title: Stage 5.5 Frame-Level Prediction Calibration Hard229 Conditional Protocol
proxy_label: weak-frame temporal proxy (Macro-F1); NOT an official score
scientific_question: Does the exact immutable Dev166 winner generalize to Hard229 without recall or precision regression versus FS-0?

FS-0.description: identity control: keep every candidate frame; bbox unchanged

FS-1.description: drop left/right edge-connected runs where E_t >= 2 and S_t == 1, only when a higher-consensus core (S_t >= 2) exists

FS-2.description: drop left/right edge-connected runs where E_t >= 2 and S_t < E_t, only when a unanimity core (S_t == E_t) exists

support_definition.E_t: number of original temporal inference chunks whose observable window covers frame t, using only the frozen Stage 5.1 mapping frames_in_segment(chunk_start_sec, chunk_end_sec)
support_definition.S_t: number of eligible chunks that produced at least one raw candidate covering frame t
support_definition.provenance_source: Stage 4.2 Frozen Candidate Cache record: source_chunks + raw_candidates
support_definition.no_reimplementation: chunk/support membership reuses the Stage 5.1 canonical mapping

stage5_1_mapping.rule: CFR_FPS: ceil(start*fps) .. ceil(end*fps)-1, clamped to [0, frame_count); PTS_TABLE: bisect_left on exact fractional PTS; no local fps rounding, start floor or end ceil is reimplemented

metrics.proxy_label: weak-frame temporal proxy (Macro-F1); NOT an official score

hard_timing_derivation.reason: Stage 5.1 metadata cache and Stage 5.4 TS-5 output are Dev166-only
hard_timing_derivation.method: deterministic ffprobe of the frozen dataset window at stage3_frozen_predictions[video_id].source_video_path using the project frozen probe_video; verified byte-for-byte against the Dev166 metadata cache
hard_timing_derivation.spatial_output: Hard229 has no Stage 5.4 TS-5 bbox output because Stage 5.4 was Dev-only; the FS-* policy only changes the emit mask, so Hard229 is evaluated frame-only

dev_winner_immutability.rule: Hard229 compares only FS-0 versus the exact candidate frozen by the immutable Dev promotion marker
forbidden: manual override of the Dev winner
Hard229 before a valid immutable Dev promotion marker
weak-frame proxy reported as an official score
